chapter_keywords: A Record of a Mortal’s Journey to Immortality
chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch. 314: The Black Fiend Master’s True Identity & the Unbreakable Rule
chapter_meta_description: Han Li extracts the Black Fiend Master’s secret from a captive, but the truth leads him to a forbidden zone—the Imperial Palace—guarded by a rule that could get him punished rather than rewarded.
og_title: RMJI Chapter 314: The Rule That Binds
og_description: Han Li cracks the case, but the final enemy isn’t a demonic cultivator—it’s an ancient law of the Seven Great Sects.
twitter_title: RMJI 314: A victory that feels like a trap.
twitter_description: Han Li finds the Black Fiend Sect Master, but the Imperial Palace is off-limits. Sometimes the system punishes the righteous.

lore_anchors.definition: A common but effective hypnosis spell that allows a cultivator with vastly superior mental power to bend a weaker opponent’s will and extract information.
A deadly poison pill used to silently assassinate a captive, delivering a painless but certain death.
The ritualistic slaughter of living beings (here, over a dozen cultivators) to fuel demonic cultivation, representing the ultimate, unforgivable cruelty in the cultivation world.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn’t Han Li just fly into the Imperial Palace and kill the Black Fiend Sect Master?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because the Seven Great Sects have an ancient, unwritten rule forbidding any cultivator from entering the Imperial Capital to prevent one sect from seizing control of the mortal emperor. Breaking this rule could get him severely punished, even if he is in the right.
It is a silent, lethal poison designed to kill a helpless victim without any trace of struggle, effectively a tool for a clean, quiet assassination.
